name: STAR Geodesy — Albers equal-area conic
summary: Albers equal-area conic projection, forward, inverse and both scale factors, for cones in either hemisphere and the tangent cone; within 1.9e-6 m of PROJ and 9.1e-7 m of PyGeodesy on 600 cases; reproduces Snyder's published coordinates and scale factors and refuses degenerate cones.
reference: Snyder, Map Projections - A Working Manual (USGS PP 1395), p. 292: Clarke 1866, parallels 29.5 N and 45.5 N, origin 23 N 96 W, point 35 N 75 W: x = 1885472.7 m, y = 1535925.0 m, h = 1.0085173, k = 0.9915546

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: degrees and metres; x East, y North, no false origin; the ellipsoid is an explicit argument
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input and for degenerate cones; Newton iteration capped at 12 steps; loss of digits for nearly equal parallels documented
